LESSON: ISLAMIC ETIQUETTE TEACHINGS

Grade: PP1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: MORAL
Topic 4.1: Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we greet?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the importance • Learners practice Islamic greeting e.g.. of using Islamic greeting skit/role-play. in daily life • Learners listen to and sing songs
2. apply Islamic greeting related to Islamic greeting. appropriately while • In pairs or small groups

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate the importance • Learners practice Islamic greeting e.g.. of using Islamic greeting skit/role-play. in daily life • Learners listen to and sing songs
   In simple words: practise until you can appreciate the importance • Learners practice Islamic greeting e.g.. of using Islamic greeting skit/role-play. in daily life • Learners listen to and sing songs. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. apply Islamic greeting related to Islamic greeting. appropriately while • In pairs or small groups
   In simple words: practise until you can apply Islamic greeting related to Islamic greeting. appropriately while • In pairs or small groups. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS in the examples.
2. Explain Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS.
4. Show that you can: appreciate the importance • Learners practice Islamic greeting e.g.. of using Islamic greeting skit/role-play. in daily life • Learners listen to and sing songs

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

2. Learners listen to and sing songs c) apply Islamic greeting related to Islamic greeting. appropriately while
